verses.text: Ix el lemnaj winhaj David t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá, ix b'at yilan winhaj Jonatán winh, yik syal winh t'a winh: --¿Tas wal in mul? ¿Tom ay wal junok in mul te chuk ix in k'ulej t'a winh a mam, yuj chi' tzin sayek' winh yik tzin smilanchamok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh jab'ok, manh ol ach chamlaj. Scham a na'ani to a masanil tas sk'ulej winh in mam chi', syalnhej winh t'ayin, wach'chom niwan yelk'ochi, ma kennhej. ¿Tom ijan manh ol yal winh t'ayin yuj jun tik? Ma'ay amlaj, xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj David chi' yalani: --Yojtak winh a mam chi' to te wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' max yal-laj winh t'ayach, max yal-laj sk'ol winh tzojtakejeli, yik max ach kusi. Palta yojtakxo Jehová to ayxo och chamel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Tato ay junok b'aj syal ach in kolani, al t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Ha k'ik'an tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, yowalil tzin em k'ojan in wa t'a stz'ey winh rey chi'. Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol tzin k'ub'ejkanel in b'a t'a kaltak te' tik, masanto t'a yemk'uhalil chab'ej.
Tato tzin sk'anb'ej winh a mam chi', tzal t'a winh to a t'ayach ix in k'ana' to tzin b'atkan t'a Belén in chonhab', yujto a masanil heb' in k'ab' wok ol ak'anoch k'inh ichataxon t'a junjun ab'il.
Yik'okab' tas tzal chi', tato xchi winh, wach' wik syal chi'. Tato skot yowal winh jun, syalelk'ochi to na'anxo yuj winh in smilanchamok.

Ina to toxo ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' tzin k'an jun tik t'ayach. Palta tato yel ay in mul, syal in a milanchamok, manh yowalilok tzin ik'b'at t'a yichanh winh a mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh a na icha chi', tato ix wab' spekal to snib'ej winh in mam chi' tzach smilchamok, toxom ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
--¿Mach pax ol halan t'ayin, tato chuk ol aj stak'wok winh t'ayach? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Konh wet'ok, konh el t'a spatikel chonhab' tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh b'aj manhxalaj anima, ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal to yel swala'. Ha k'ik'an, ma chab'ej yab' icha tik, tzin k'anb'ej t'a winh in mam chi', tas nab'il yuj winh. Tato wach' tas sna' winh t'a a patik, swalkot ab'i.

Tato chuk spensar winh t'a a patik jun, aokab' Jehová ol ak'an in yahelal tato max wal t'ayach yuj tas ol aj a kolan a b'a. Haxo tikne'ik, kolwajokab' Jehová het'ok icha ix aj skolwaj yet' winh in mam chi'.
Ha tikne'ik, tato pitzaninto ol ach ochkan reyal, tzin k'an t'ayach to ol ok' a k'o'ol t'ayin icha yok'elk'olal Jehová t'ayach, manh ol in a milchamlaj.
Tato toxo in cham jun, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza nakot winhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Ayik ol satjiel heb' ajk'ol yuj Jehová, mokab' satel in b'inaj t'a a makb'en, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'oankan strato winhaj Jonatán chi' yet' winhaj David chi', ol b'eynhejb'at t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj David chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an a yahelal tato manh ol elk'och tas skalkan tik, xchi winh.
Yujto te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to swach' b'oejxikan jun strato heb' winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Jonatán chi': --K'ik'an tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, scheklaji to malaj ach yujto sekan tz'ajkan b'aj tzach em k'ojan.
Palta haxo chab'ej t'a yemk'uhalil, sb'at a k'ub'ejel a b'a b'aj a k'ub'ejnakel a b'a junel. Tza tanhwej t'a slak'anil k'e'en k'e'en skuch Ezel.
Tzin julb'at oxeok in jul-lab' ta', ichato ay junok mach b'aj wan in julwajb'ati.

Slajwi chi', swalan t'a winh in chekab': Ixik b'at ik'kot in jul-lab' chi', xin cham t'a winh. Tato swal t'a winh icha tik: Ha t'a yichanhkot tik ay, ik'kot te', ta xin chi, tzach kot t'a junk'olal, malaj tas ol ach ik'an syal chi'. Toxo ix wak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to icha chi' ol wutej.
Palta tato swal jun: Ha jun in jul-lab' chi', najatto ay t'a ichanhb'at chi', tato xin chi t'a winh, tzach b'at t'a najat a kol a b'a yujto a Jehová tzach chekanb'ati.
Ha pax t'a ko ti' ix kalkan tik jun, a Jehová testigo tz'ajkan t'ay to junelnhej skalkani, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a winhaj David chi' t'a kaltak te'. Ayik ix chajiel yich yik tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Saúl swa'i.

Ha t'a sat pat ix em k'ojan winh t'a b'ajtaxon tz'em k'ojan. Ha t'a yichanh winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Jonatán, haxo t'a stz'ey winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Abner, haxo pax xila winhaj David, malaj mach ix em k'ojan t'ay.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, malaj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi', yujto ix sna winh icha tik: Tekan ay junok tas manh wach'ok ix sk'ulej winhaj David chi', maj am yal sb'o'an sb'a winh icha yalan ley t'a ayokto, xchi winh t'a spensar chi'.

Schab'ilxo k'uhal yajoch k'inh chi', kolannhej xila winhaj David chi', malaj mach tz'em k'ojan t'ay. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj jawi winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' wa'el tikne'ik yet' ewi? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winhaj David chi' halan t'ayin ewi,

tob' masanil heb' sk'ab' yok winh sna'an k'inh yik silab' t'a schonhab', yuj chi' ix awtajb'at winh yuj jun winh yuk'tak. Yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Tato wach' in t'a a sat, cha in b'at wak' tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol yet' heb' wuk'tak chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' max jawilaj winh wa'el t'a a mexa tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Mitz' unin ach, b'ajam sik'b'il ach. Wojtak to wach' ak'an yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', yik k'ixwelal tzach ajkan yet' ix a nun.

¿Tom max nachajel jab'ok u'uj to yakb'an pitzan winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', manh ol ach och reyal yet' pax heb' inhtilal? Ha tikne'ik, ak'b'at sayumal winh, tzik'ankot winh t'ayin, ol in milancham winh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ol cham winh? ¿Tom ay junok tas chuk ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' icha chi' tzala'? xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix sjulanb'at jun k'e'en slanza winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' yik smilancham winh. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj Jonatán chi' to ha' winh smam winh chi', snib'ej winh smilcham winhaj David chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix k'e juknaj winh, ix elta winh. Majxo walaj winh yet' heb' winh t'a schab'il k'uhal chi', yujto ix kus winh yuj winhaj David chi', yujto te chuk tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' ix yab' winh.
T'a wal sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winh yil winhaj David chi', icha yaj yalankan heb' winh, tzak'anoch jun winh kelem unin yuj winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh kelem chi': --Elanhchamel ol b'at ik'kot in jul-lab' ol in julb'at tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh kelem chi' b'i'an. Ha wal sb'at winh chi', ix julwajb'at winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanhb'at winh.

Ayik ix k'och winh b'aj ix em jul-lab' chi', te cha'anh ix awaj winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Yel a k'o'ol, manh ach och wa'an, hato t'a ichanhb'at ix k'ochi, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh: --Yelk'olal a b'ati, manh ach och wa'an, xchi winh. Ix sik'ank'e jul-lab' chi' winh kelem chi', ix yik'ankot winh.
Palta maj nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj winh tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jonatán chi', anhej winh ojtannak yet' winhaj David tas yaj jun slolonel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sjul-lab' winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh kelem chi', ix schekan meltzaj winh winh t'a chonhab'.

Ixnhej b'atkan winh kelem chi', ix elkankot winhaj David t'a spatik k'e'en k'e'en. Ixnhej elta winh chi', oxel ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winhaj Jonatán chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stz'ub'lanelta sti' heb' winh, ix ok' heb' winh schawanhil, ix sik'sik'an wal winhaj David chi' yok'i.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, junk'olal a b'ati yujto a ko ti' ix kak' ko chawanhil, t'a yichanh Jehová ix kala'. Ix ko k'an t'a Jehová chi' to aynhejokab'och ket'ok ko chawanhil yet' heb' kinhtilal yik tz'elkank'och b'aj ix kak' ko ti', yik wach'nhej pax kak'ani yet' heb' kinhtilal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix meltzajkankot winh t'a chonhab'.
